title: Parameterizable Barrel Shifter
constraints: Parameter `WIDTH` (a power of two, default 8). `din`/`dout` are WIDTH bits and `shamt` is log₂(WIDTH) bits. The judge uses **WIDTH = 16**.
`op`: 00 = shift left logical, 01 = shift right logical, 10 = shift right arithmetic (sign fill), 11 = rotate right.
hints: A log shifter uses log₂(WIDTH) stages. Stage k shifts by 2ᵏ when `shamt[k]` is set. A `for` loop over the stages can build it.
Fill bits per operation: zeros (SLL, SRL), copies of the sign bit (SRA), or the bits that fell off the other end (ROR).
Rotate right by k = `(din >> k) | (din << (WIDTH - k))`, keeping only WIDTH bits.
